subject: Deployment mode triage & PoC playbook — HealthPilot
messages:
From: Alan Chu <alan.chu@healthpilot.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Agarwal <priyaa@healthpilot.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Initial call recap: Redwood trial and infra constraints

Hi Sofia & Ben,

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap from our side and the things we need to validate during a PoC. Priya (CTO) asked me to capture the priorities so we stay aligned: 

- Data type: PHI-containing clinical notes and patient metadata (must remain in our environment).
- Throughput: expected steady-state ~60 QPS, bursts up to 120 QPS.
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for short prompts (~64 tokens).
- Compliance: HIPAA and SOC2 references required; we also need audit logs and key management integration.
- Timeline: procurement + security review about ~8–12 weeks; we want a short PoC first to validate model quality and infra approach.

Ask: Can Redwood outline the minimal PoC that proves (a) model output meets our quality bar, (b) privacy guarantees for PHI, and (c) performance at our QPS/latency targets?

If helpful, our stakeholders who should be involved are: Priya Agarwal (CTO), myself (Infrastructure Lead), and Shreya Rao (Security Manager — she’s copied indirectly).

Thanks,
Alan

--
Alan Chu
Infrastructure Lead, HealthPilot
alan.chu@healthpilot.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: none in this note
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alan Chu <alan.chu@healthpilot.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial call recap: Redwood trial and infra constraints

Alan — great summary, this is exactly what we needed. I pulled together a concise triage and proposed PoC playbook (attached) so we can agree the fastest, lowest-risk path forward. High-level guidance from our side: 

- Quick validation path (fastest time-to-insight): Hosted Redwood API using synthetic or redacted sample data. Pros: fastest to stand up, no infra changes. Cons: not appropriate for unredacted PHI in prod.
- Predictable-performance path: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool). Pros: throughput/latency SLOs, isolation at the customer level. Cons: requires commercial commitment but can be staged as a short-term reserved trial.
- Compliance-first path: Private VPC (customer-controlled network / on-prem variant). Pros: meets PHI residency and KMS/HSM needs; supports SOC2/HIPAA audits. Cons: longer onboarding and network whitelisting.

Proposed 4-week PoC plan (we can compress or expand as you prefer):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff + network & security checklist (we'll send a one-page network whitelist and KMS integration notes).
2) Week 1 — Baseline model quality on Hosted API (redacted samples) so Priya & team can confirm outputs quickly.
3) Week 2-3 — Private VPC trial deployment (or Dedicated pool if you prefer) to validate throughput/latency with your real-ish traffic and KMS.
4) Week 4 — Wrap: perf report, evaluation against success criteria, decisions on go-forward mode.

Success criteria we recommend measuring in the PoC:
- Quality: 5 sample prompt categories, average human score >= 4/5 on accuracy/relevance.
- Performance: sustained 60 QPS with bursts to 120 QPS; p95 latency < 200ms.
- Security: no customer PHI stored in hosted logs; audit log visibility and KMS ok.

Attachments (stubs): redwood-poc-template.pdf (PoC checklist & evaluation matrix), network-requirements.xlsx (whitelist + ports). I attached both — please confirm you can open them.

Can you confirm: (A) whether you want us to start with Hosted quick validation or go straight to a Private VPC evaluation, and (B) a 30-minute slot for a technical sync this week? Our suggested tech sync windows: Tue/Wed 10–12 PST.

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-poc-template.pdf (application/pdf), network-requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Cc: Priya Agarwal <priyaa@healthpilot.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 4:20 PM sofia_ivanova@redwood.com wrote:
> Alan — great summary, this is exactly what we needed. I pulled together a concise triage and proposed PoC playbook (attached) so we can agree the fastest, lowest-risk path forward.
> 
> (snip)

Thanks, Sofia — helpful framing. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Our security team strongly prefers Private VPC for any unredacted data; however, we can accept starting with redacted/synthetic data on Hosted to evaluate model quality. That would shorten the time to a first read.
- For the Dedicated option: what is the minimum commitment term and approximate monthly run-rate for a trial that meets our QPS?
- Data residency: we need the PoC logs and any persisted artifacts to remain in our VPC or be accessible for audit; is Redwood able to guarantee that for the Private VPC path?

We can do a short technical sync Wednesday 10am PST — please send calendar invite. Priya will join that call.

Alan

--
Alan Chu
Infrastructure Lead, HealthPilot

Subject: Re: Initial call recap: Redwood trial and infra constraints

Alan — perfect, thanks. Calendar invite sent for Wed 2027-05-26 10:00 AM PST (we had a calendar collision in the system; confirmed with Priya that Thu was tight). If that time becomes an issue, flag it and we'll move.

Short answers ahead of the sync so you have context: 
- Dedicated minimum: for trials we can provision a 30-day reserved pool with no long-term commitment; rough estimate for a pool sized to your QPS is $Xk/month — Marcus (cc'd) will follow up with exact pricing and a facture.
- Private VPC guarantees: yes — for Private VPC we can ensure no hosted logs leave your VPC, KMS/HSM integration for key control, and audit log exports to your logging endpoint. We'll include the controls matrix in the kickoff packet.

Immediate next actions (owners & timeline):
- Alan: confirm final attendee list for the Wed tech sync (today EOD).
- Priya: if you have any mandatory controls docs, share them ahead of the call.
- Marcus: send provisional trial pricing and a short rundown of what a 30-day reserved Dedicated pool looks like.
- Sofia: send network whitelist + short-run PoC timeline (attached).

We’ll also push a short pre-call checklist to help Shreya/Risk prepare. Looking forward to the sync — talk soon.

Best,
Sofia
